source: Actual completed runs used for the MNIST 10k DOCX; no algorithms rerun during export
timestamp_note: Individual UTC start/finish times were not recorded. Native history timestamps are estimates from source JSON file mtime and the recorded total_wall_sec. Scenario duration is the span of its separate workers, including gaps and refreshed HF runs; runtime_sec remains the original algorithm measurement.
metric_note: ARI/AMI/NMI on all 10000 records. Internal geometry on assigned records in StandardScaler(original raw X); silhouette uses the repository fixed 2000-record reference.
round_history_note: Only history actually recorded by each adapter is preserved. Empty history means no per-round trace was recorded, not an unsuccessful run. DP proxy results are marked explicitly.

protocol.dp_preprocessing: fixed public pixels [0,1] then L2 clip
protocol.code_changes: current working tree with fixes from this conversation
protocol.missing_original_parameters: delta and clip norm inferred from repository protocol
protocol.hf_dbscan_exact_optimization: Empty server cell set implies all-noise labels; skip useless per-point neighbor construction. Original author source unchanged; equivalence regression passed.
protocol.checks: 194 base tests passed; 6 base skips (4 require display, optional Flower checked separately). MNIST public-pixel aggregate-DP support validated.
